'''Eisek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|navy]] who was in command of the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnaught]] ''[[Valor Prevails]]'' that patrolled the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]] during the final year of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. After capturing [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Theron Shan]] and his companions, Eisek attempted to make a deal with the SIS agent about the Empire's super weapons that were designed. Theron accepted his offer, but he places him in a cell after knocking him out unconscious. He was killed moments later by [[Darth Mekhis]] for his betrayal.
